prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1317; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: This is the recorded statement for claim reference number on the sideswipe incident. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the basics, I guess. You can use the claimant placeholder.

Q: Understood. Can you tell me where the incident took place?

A: It was on the access road near the Conroe area in Texas, right where the lanes merge by the shopping center. I was trying to move over into the right lane.

Q: What time of day was it, and what were the weather and road conditions like?

A: Late afternoon, maybe around four or five. It was clear and dry. Traffic was moderate, not stopped or anything.

Q: Walk me through what happened as you were changing lanes.

A: I checked my mirror, saw the lane looked open, and signaled. I started to move over, and then I felt a hard bump on my left side. The other vehicle had come up in my blind spot and kept coming as I drifted. Our mirrors kind of scraped and my car jerked toward the shoulder.

Q: Did you have any contact with the other driver afterward?

A: Briefly. They pulled over ahead of me. We exchanged insurance information, and they said they didn't see me coming over.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same evening. My neck is stiff and sore, and my lower back aches, especially when I sit for a long time or turn my head to check traffic.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries or treatment to your neck or back?

A: No, nothing serious. I had some minor soreness years ago but nothing that needed a doctor.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and I'm still dealing with the pain. I'd like this taken care of as soon as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
